name: Figma
rundown: Figma is a web-based UI design tool that's become the go-to for designers building everything from mobile apps to websites. It’s all about collaborative, real-time design, streamlining workflows and letting teams work together seamlessly. With over 13 million users, Figma has fundamentally shifted how digital products are conceptualized and built.

timeline.event: Founded by Dylan Field and Evan Wallace
Launched the initial version of Figma
Released Figma 2.0 with improved collaboration features

notableFacts: Figma is entirely browser-based, eliminating the need for local software installations.
It pioneered a fully collaborative design workflow in the web application space.
The platform's real-time co-editing makes it ideal for remote and distributed teams.
